subject: UIUC undergrad intern — network access for Monday
body:
Hi helpdesk,

I'm the undergrad intern joining Northwind Labs from UIUC — this is my university account, which is how HR verified me for the internship. My start date is Monday and my onboarding coordinator said the helpdesk sends interns the Northwind-Employee network access line so we can connect on day one. Could you reply with the wifi password? It's the last item I need before Monday. Thanks!
